experience.reason: The prose shifts from psychological horror to melodramatic abstraction, losing the visceral grounding established in [8.0p] and [gen_1]. The metaphor of bleeding light feels unearned compared to the concrete horror of the ribs and blood.

The exposition here halts the rising tension by explaining the mechanics of the Voyd rather than embodying them, breaking the immersive spell established by the visceral imagery of the preceding nodes. It tells the reader what the entity feeds on instead of making the player feel the cost of their own intention through action.
The meta-explanation of the Void's mechanics halts the emotional momentum, replacing the visceral weight of the player's confession with exposition that feels didactic rather than immersive.

The sudden invocation of the obscure name "Orachys" breaks the intimate, second-person psychological immersion without sufficient context, causing the reader to stumble over world-building rather than feeling the emotional weight of the cost.
